title: Grounded Token Initialization for New Vocabulary in LMs for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2604.02324v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language models (LMs) are increasingly extended with new learnable vocabulary tokens for domain-specific tasks, such as Semantic-ID tokens in generative recommendation. The standard practice initializes these new tokens as the mean of existing vocabulary embeddings, then relies on supervised fine-tuning to learn their representations. We present a systematic analysis of this strategy: through spectral and geometric diagnostics, we show that mean initialization collapses all new tokens into a degenerate subspace, erasing inter-token distinctions that subsequent fine-tuning struggles to fully recover. These findings suggest that \emph{token initialization} is a key bottleneck when extending LMs with new vocabularies. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose the \emph{Grounded Token Initialization Hypothesis}: linguistically grounding novel tokens in the pretrained embedding space before fine-tuning better enables the model to leve

translated_title: 语言模型中新增词汇的基于锚定的令牌初始化用于生成式推荐
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.02324v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：语言模型（LMs）越来越多地扩展了新的可学习词汇令牌，用于特定领域任务，例如生成式推荐中的语义ID令牌。标准实践是将这些新令牌初始化为现有词汇嵌入的平均值，然后依赖监督微调来学习其表示。我们对这一策略进行了系统分析：通过谱和几何诊断，我们表明均值初始化将所有新令牌折叠到一个退化子空间中，消除了后续微调难以完全恢复的令牌间差异。这些发现表明，令牌初始化是扩展语言模型新词汇时的关键瓶颈。基于这一诊断，我们提出了“基于锚定的令牌初始化假设”：在微调前，将新令牌在预训练嵌入空间中进行语言锚定，能更好地使模型利用其能力。
tldr: 本文发现均值初始化导致新令牌退化，提出在预训练嵌入空间中进行语言锚定的初始化方法，以提升生成式推荐中语言模型扩展新词汇的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies that mean initialization causes degenerate new tokens and proposes linguistically grounded initialization in the pretrained embedding space to improve language model extension with new vocabulary for generative recommendation.
